intro: Historian Karnik gives you a sealed note for Advisor Belgrum. You are to tell Belgrum what you have witnessed and ask how Belgrum wants to proceed, while Karnik turns to Hammertoe's spirit about the Shadowforge in the Badlands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, run and find Advisor Belgrum as quickly as you can. Tell him what you've witnessed and ask him how he wants us to proceed. This note will explain more to him.
In the meantime, I will take the time to speak to Hammertoe's spirit. Maybe he knows something that will help us put a stop to those Shadowforge cretins' activities in the Badlands. We can only pray.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, word from Historian Karnik. Excellent.
I always have time for his business.
